newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares close unchanged, mood cautious.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares close unchanged, mood cautious.

text.p: Danish share prices closed a fraction higher on Wednesday, with dealers seeing levels holding in a wary market until the U.S. data at the end of the week.

"Investors are cautious ahead of the American data so I don't see the KFX index moving much tomorrow in any direction or anything very dramatic happening. Tomorrow's turnover will be low just like today," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index gained a marginal 0.05 point or 0.03 percent to close at 152.75 in overall bourse turnover of 719 million crowns. The KFX June future rose 0.90 point to 151.40 with 60 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Unidanmark was the day's most traded paper with 195,000 shares changing hands, to close four crowns down at 335.
